items.source: Constructor accepting a CorsConfigurationSource used by the filter to find the CorsConfiguration to use for each incoming request.
items.translation: 接受 `CorsConfigurationSource` 的构造函数，供过滤器使用以查找每个传入请求要使用的 `CorsConfiguration`。

items.source: This filter could be used in conjunction with DelegatingFilterProxy in order to help with its initialization.
items.translation: 此过滤器可与DelegatingFilterProxy配合使用，以帮助其初始化。

items.source: By default DefaultCorsProcessor is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用DefaultCorsProcessor。

items.source: This is an alternative to configuring CORS in the Spring MVC Java config and the Spring MVC XML namespace. It is useful for applications depending only on spring-web (not on spring-webmvc) or for security constraints that require CORS checks to be performed at Filter level.
items.translation: 这是配置 Spring MVC Java 配置和 Spring MVC XML 命名空间中 CORS 的替代方案。它适用于仅依赖 spring-web（而非 spring-webmvc）的应用程序，或需要以Filter级别执行 CORS 检查的安全约束。

items.source: Configure a custom CorsProcessor to use to apply the matched CorsConfiguration for a request.
items.translation: 配置一个自定义的 CorsProcessor，用于为请求应用匹配的 CorsConfiguration。

items.source:
• CORS W3C recommendation
  • UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource
items.translation:
• CORS W3C 推荐标准
  • UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource

items.source:
Provides HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse arguments instead of the
default ServletRequest and ServletResponse ones.
items.translation: 提供 HttpServletRequest 和 HttpServletResponse 参数，而不是默认的 ServletRequest 和 ServletResponse。

items.source: Same contract as for doFilter, but guaranteed to be just invoked once per request within a single request thread.
items.translation: 与doFilter相同的合同，但保证在单个请求线程中每个请求仅被调用一次。
`doFilterInternal` 在类 `OncePerRequestFilter` 中。
